And after the roots denoting inclination, understanding, or respect, the affix क्त is used with the force of the present

Terms: क्त

The affix अण् comes in the sense of descendant after the word मातृ when it is preceded by a Numeral or by the words सम् or भद्र and the letter उ is substituted for the final ऋ of मातृ।

Terms: अण्

So also after the word मातृष्वसृ the affix छण् is added and the final is elided when ढक् follows in forming Patronymic.

Terms: छण्

The affix अञ् comes in the quadruple sense after a word which ends in the affix मतुप् and whose stem is polysyllabic.

Terms: चातुर्थिक-अञ्

The affix यत् comes after words 1. मत 2. जन and 3. हल in the senses respectively of 1. 'means 2. 'gossip' and 3. 'drawing', the words being in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction.

Terms: यत्

The affix यत् comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) with the force of मतुप्‌ after a word in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction, the word so formed meaning 'a month' or 'a body'.

Terms: छन्दस्-यत्

The affix घ comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) with the force of मतुप् after the word सहस्र।

Terms: घ
When a सूक्त or साम्न् is to be expressed, the affix छ (ईय) comes after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) in the sense of the affix मतुप् -- तदस्यास्त्यस्मिन्निति मतुप्‌

The आ before the affix मत् has the acute accent, when the word is a name in the Feminine Gender.

Terms: accent-तिङ्

The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the words 1. मात्रा 2. उपज्ञा 3. उपक्रम and 4. छाया when these words appear as neuter.

Terms: तत्-पुरुष समास

According to Northern Grammarians मातरपितरौ is a valid form.

Terms: विभक्ति-Non-elision

The final vowel of a word consisting of more than two syllables in lengthened before the affix मत् when it is a name, but not of the words अजिर् etc.

Terms: संहिता Lengthening

For the final affixes मत् and वस् there is substituted रु in the Vocative Case singular, in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: Nasal रु

ष् is optionally substituted for the स् of स्वसृ after मातृ and पितृ in a compound.

Terms: ष change

ष् is optionally substituted for the स् of स्वसृ after मातुर् and पितुर् in a compound.

Terms: ष change
